title: RunRecord
description: One bean processed under one set of conditions. The existing steps.jsonl and telemetry-report.sh record what HAPPENED; this record fixes what it happened UNDER. Two runs are only comparable when their conditions differ in exactly the dimension under test — without this record, a Q4 run and a Q8 run are two anecdotes rather than one experiment.

corpus.description: Which frozen requirements, and which derived bean set. The requirements hash is what proves the input never moved between runs.

requirements_sha256.description: Hash of the frozen requirements document. A change here invalidates comparison against every prior run.

bean_set.description: Version of the derived bean set, e.g. 'v1'. Beans are regenerated as intake improves; bean-set quality is itself a dimension under test.

conditions.description: Everything that could change the outcome. Any field left unset makes a comparison along that axis unsound.

stack.description: Target tech stack for this build of the corpus, e.g. 'python-fastapi', 'typescript-react'. The same beans built into a different stack is a valid experiment.

skill_versions.description: Content hash per skill actually loaded. Skill text is the primary thing the outside builder tunes, so a run is not reproducible without it.

regime.description: From the Phase-0 measurement in effect at run time.

outcome.description: The comparable result. Populated when the run reaches a terminal state.

human_verdict.description: Ground truth. A run that produced a PR the human rejected is not a success, whatever the judge said.

rejection_reason.description: Per spec §11. Only defect / requirement_miss / security (and doc_quality at document stages) count as false approvals.

digest.description: Ollama digest. The tag can be re-pointed at new weights; the digest cannot.
